extracted.intended_audience: researchers, universities, companies, and organizations seeking Navy/Marine Corps S&T funding (potential proposers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for submitting proposals under the Office of Naval Research FY25 Long Range Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) for Navy and Marine Corps Science & Technology, including legal authority, required templates, deadlines, and conflict-of-interest policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: BAA legal/authority basis
rubrics_metrics.description: This publication constitutes a Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) for awards by the Office of Naval Research (ONR) Contact and Grants Awards Management Division, ONR Code 25 (or others approved by Code 25), ONR Global (ONRG) and the Marine Corps Warfighting Lab (MCWL), as contemplated in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016 and by the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment Guide to Research Other Transactions Under 10 U.S.C. 4021 (JUN 2023) and the Other Transaction Guide version 2.0 dated July 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The announcement is issued under the cited FAR and Other Transaction guidance; proposers should recognize the legal/administrative authorities and applicable acquisition/OT guidance referenced in the BAA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merit-based, competitive procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: The BAA 'constitutes a merit-based, competitive procedure, in accordance with the Department of Defense Grant and Agreement Regulations (DoDGARS), at 32 CFR 22.315(a).'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals will be evaluated in a competitive, merit-based manner per DoDGARS; proposers should prepare submissions consistent with merit evaluation expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: No formal RFP will be issued
rubrics_metrics.description: A formal Request for Proposals (RFP), solicitation, and/or additional information regarding this announcement will not be issued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This BAA itself is the solicitation mechanism; do not expect or rely on a separate RFP—follow the instructions and materials provided with the BAA and its amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: References to ONR include ONRG and MCWL
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless indicated otherwise, any references to ONR within the BAA refers to ONR, ONRG and MCWL.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpretational clarification: where the BAA says 'ONR', it encompasses ONR, ONR Global, and the Marine Corps Warfighting Lab unless an exception is stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Full Proposals will be accepted until: September 30, 2026 2:00 PM EST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposers must ensure full proposals are submitted by this deadline (date/time are Eastern Standard Time). Check the full BAA text for any additional time-zone or electronic submission method specifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory standardized templates for technical and cost proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Required: All BAAs incorporate a standardized template for the submission of technical and cost proposals for all contract awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the required ONR standardized technical and cost proposal templates/spreadsheets for contract award submissions; failure to use the templates may affect acceptability. The page provides downloadable forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance and assistance via BAA points of contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and assistance in completing the form and spreadsheet can be obtained from points of contact provided in the BAA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If proposers need help filling required forms/templates, they should contact the POCs listed in the full BAA; the public landing page links to contact information and downloadable forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult full text and amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Please see full text of the announcement for additional information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The landing page links multiple PDF documents and amendments (Amendment 0001–0006, redlined/clean versions, and related spreadsheets). Proposers must consult the full BAA and the most current amendment/version for complete requirements, changes, and instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational conflicts of interest policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Conflicts of Interest: To ensure fairness in the consideration of proposals, ONR has implemented policies to protect against organizational conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposers must be aware of and comply with ONR policies regarding organizational conflicts of interest; consult the full BAA text for the specific policy details, disclosure requirements, and mitigation expectations.
